deploy-bot: 🚀 staging deploy started
env: `staging`
initiated_by: @elaine
commit: `7f3c9b2`
tag: `v2.8.0-rc7`
change-window: 02:00-03:00 UTC
runbook: <https://runbook.internal/redwood/staging-rollout|runbook>
canary: starting 5% traffic -> 6 pods (worker-pool-stg)
notes: autoscaler pre-warmed, KV cache snapshot loaded

elaine: kicking off wave1 smoke now. I'll watch traces + latency for 10m.

vivek: pinned reranker service to `7f3c9b2` on staging to avoid model mismatch with baseline. Mentioning because rollout touches reranker routing.

sam: any DB migrations in this set?

elaine: light migration (ADD COLUMN) — non-blocking. migration job queued as `migration-job-stg-2026-03-21`.

sam: ok good. can you paste the kubectl job command for oncall to monitor?

elaine: sure — run:
```
kubectl get job migration-job-stg-2026-03-21 -n staging -o yaml
kubectl logs job/migration-job-stg-2026-03-21 -n staging
```

ci-bot: smoke-tests: started -> `staging-smoke-suite-516789` (watch: https://ci.internal/redwood/516789)

oncall: if we see >1% 5xx or latency p95 spike >200ms during canary, we should pause and roll back. Plan to pin back to `v2.7.9` and scale new pods down.

elaine: agreed. rollback steps in runbook, TL;DR:
- flip routing: `kubectl set image deployment/api api=redwood/api:v2.7.9 -n staging`
- scale down worker pool: `kubectl scale deployment worker-pool-stg --replicas=0 -n staging`
- re-pin reranker if needed: `rerankerctl pin --tag v2.7.9`

matt: seeing canary logs — token service latency looks stable, no error trend yet. 👍

ci-bot: smoke-tests: green ✅ (all checks passed)

deploy-bot: canary health: passed. shifting traffic 50% -> 100% over 6m (progressing)

vivek: noticed one throttling log in reranker at 50% traffic, looked transient. monitoring.

elaine: holding for 2m additional observation then finish.

oncall: thumbs on alerting dashboards, no pager so far.

deploy-bot: ✅ staging deploy complete
env: `staging`

notes: canary -> full; smoke tests green; no rollback actions taken :party-parrot: 

elaine: thanks all — will open a short release note for dedicated review and then schedule the prod changewindow.

sam: nice, thanks!
